purpose: Teach: 電信/依拠/手がける/内地/買い換え/受取/田舎町/廃業

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、緊急時は電信でも連絡を取れ
lines.en: In emergencies, we need to be reachable by telegraph as well.
lines.style: Clipped, authoritative. Sharp attack on the opening. Measured pace. The tone of someone stating operational fact, not inviting debate.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。市場分析は信頼できるデータに依拠しております
lines.en: Yes. Our market analysis relies only on data we can trust.
lines.style: Formal, measured. Slight emphasis on 「信頼できる」 — assuring. Steady rhythm. Respectful distance maintained in the voice.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、新事業を手がける部署を作れ
lines.en: We're establishing a new division to handle our growth ventures.
lines.style: Decisive, clear command. Slight pause before 「部署を作れ」 equivalent — the weight of the decision. Not harsh, but brooking no hesitation.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。本社は内地に置く方針を維持します
lines.en: Yes. We'll maintain our policy of keeping headquarters in the main islands.
lines.style: Formal confirmation. Steady, methodical delivery. Slight emphasis on 「維持します」 — affirming continuity. Even-handed.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、社用車の買い換え時期を見直せ
lines.en: We need to reassess the replacement schedule for our company vehicles.
lines.style: Direct, practical instruction. Brisk tempo. The tone of someone used to being obeyed without elaboration.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。お得意様の受取確認を徹底しました
lines.en: Yes. We've now standardized receipt confirmation procedures with all our key clients.
lines.style: Composed confirmation. Slight lift on 「徹底しました」 — professional pride in thorough execution. Formal, complete.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、田舎町への新店舗出店を検討しろ
lines.en: Explore opening a new branch location in a rural area.
lines.style: Strategic, forward-leaning tone. Measured but purposeful. The cadence of someone thinking about future possibility, not immediate urgency.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。廃業した店舗の整理を進めます
lines.en: Yes. We're proceeding with the closure and reorganization of the defunct location.
lines.style: Steady, concluding tone. Final confirmation. No hesitation — efficient closure. The voice of someone wrapping up one thread before moving to the next.
